parameters.threshold: ATR rises while price weakens.
parameters.reason: ATR rises while price weakens.
parameters.example: Formula example, not a live stock value: evaluate "ATR14 rising 3 days and close below 10DMA" on a complete 1W window. A true result records HIT and stores the dated input evidence.

parameters.name: High Tight Flag Failure
parameters.formula: prior strong gain + tight flag + close below flag low
parameters.threshold: Strong momentum flag breaks downward instead of continuing.
parameters.reason: Strong momentum flag breaks downward instead of continuing.
parameters.example: Formula example, not a live stock value: evaluate "prior strong gain + tight flag + close below flag low" on a complete 1-2W window. A true result records HIT and stores the dated input evidence.

parameters.name: False Reclaim Trap
parameters.formula: close above support then close below within 3D
parameters.threshold: Reclaim above support fails again quickly.
parameters.reason: Reclaim above support fails again quickly.
parameters.example: Formula example, not a live stock value: evaluate "close above support then close below within 3D" on a complete 1W window. A true result records HIT and stores the dated input evidence.

parameters.name: Opening Strength Closing Weakness
parameters.threshold: Sellers dominate after strong open repeatedly.
parameters.reason: Sellers dominate after strong open repeatedly.
parameters.example: Formula example, not a live stock value: evaluate "count(open>prior_close and close<open last7)>=3" on a complete 1W window. A true result records HIT and stores the dated input evidence.

parameters.name: Supply Wick Cluster Near High
parameters.threshold: Repeated upper wicks near resistance.
parameters.reason: Repeated upper wicks near resistance.
parameters.example: Formula example, not a live stock value: evaluate "count(upper_wick_ratio>0.45 near resistance last10)>=3" on a complete 1W window. A true result records HIT and stores the dated input evidence.

parameters.name: F&O OI Short Build
parameters.threshold: Open interest increases while price falls.
parameters.reason: Open interest increases while price falls.
parameters.example: Formula example, not a live stock value: evaluate "price down + OI up over 5D" on a complete 1-2W window. A true result records HIT and stores the dated input evidence.

parameters.name: Long Unwinding OI
parameters.formula: price down + OI down after uptrend
parameters.threshold: OI falls with price after prior rise.
parameters.reason: OI falls with price after prior rise.
parameters.example: Formula example, not a live stock value: evaluate "price down + OI down after uptrend" on a complete 1W window. A true result records HIT and stores the dated input evidence.

parameters.name: Return on Equity TTM
parameters.source: Upstox fundamentals: income statement and balance sheet
parameters.reason: Measures profit generated for each unit of shareholder capital.
parameters.example: Formula example: PAT 150 and average equity 750 gives ROE 20%, so HIT.

parameters.name: Return on Capital Employed TTM
parameters.threshold: ROCE >= 15%
parameters.source: Upstox fundamentals: income statement and balance sheet
parameters.reason: Tests operating efficiency across debt and equity capital.
parameters.example: Formula example: EBIT 240 and capital employed 1,200 gives ROCE 20%, so HIT.

parameters.name: Return on Invested Capital Spread
parameters.threshold: ROIC spread >= 3 percentage points
parameters.source: Upstox fundamentals plus configured cost of capital
parameters.reason: Requires the business to create value above its funding cost.
parameters.example: Formula example: ROIC 16% and WACC 11% gives a 5-point spread, so HIT.

parameters.name: Cash Conversion CFO to PAT
parameters.threshold: CFO/PAT >= 0.90
parameters.reason: Checks whether reported profit converts into operating cash.
parameters.example: Formula example: CFO 135 and PAT 140 gives 0.96, so HIT.

parameters.name: Free Cash Flow Margin
parameters.threshold: FCF margin >= 8%
parameters.reason: Rewards businesses retaining cash after required investment.
parameters.example: Formula example: CFO 180, capex 60 and revenue 1,000 gives 12%, so HIT.

parameters.name: Net Debt to EBITDA
parameters.threshold: Net debt/EBITDA <= 2.0
parameters.source: Upstox balance sheet and income statement
parameters.reason: Limits financial leverage before a stock can pass quality.
parameters.example: Formula example: net debt 600 and EBITDA 400 gives 1.5, so HIT.

parameters.name: Interest Coverage
parameters.threshold: Interest coverage >= 4.0
parameters.reason: Checks the operating buffer available to service debt.
parameters.example: Formula example: EBIT 240 and interest 40 gives 6.0, so HIT.

parameters.name: Operating Margin Stability
parameters.threshold: Standard deviation <= 3 percentage points
parameters.reason: Separates repeatable operating economics from erratic profitability.
parameters.example: Formula example: eight-quarter OPM deviation 2.1 points, so HIT.

parameters.name: Gross Margin Direction
parameters.threshold: Improvement >= 1 percentage point
parameters.reason: Detects improving pricing power or input-cost control.
parameters.example: Formula example: margin rises from 36% to 38%, a 2-point improvement, so HIT.

parameters.name: Asset Turnover vs Sector
parameters.formula: revenue_TTM / average_assets compared with sector median
parameters.threshold: Asset turnover >= sector median
parameters.source: Upstox fundamentals plus NSE sector map
parameters.reason: Compares operating productivity with relevant peers.
parameters.example: Formula example: stock 1.35x versus sector 1.10x, so HIT.

parameters.name: Piotroski F-Score
parameters.formula: sum(9 profitability, leverage, liquidity and efficiency tests)
parameters.threshold: F-Score >= 7 of 9
parameters.source: Upstox annual and quarterly financial statements
parameters.reason: Combines nine accounting signals into an auditable quality score.
parameters.example: Formula example: seven tests pass and two fail, score 7, so HIT.

parameters.name: Altman Z-Score
parameters.threshold: Z >= 3.0 for applicable non-financial companies
parameters.reason: Adds an explicit financial-distress screen for non-financial companies.
parameters.example: Formula example: calculated Z 3.6 is above 3.0, so HIT.

parameters.name: Quarterly Revenue Growth YoY
parameters.threshold: Revenue growth >= 12%
parameters.reason: Requires current top-line expansion.
parameters.example: Formula example: revenue rises from 1,000 to 1,150, growth 15%, so HIT.

parameters.name: Revenue Growth Acceleration
parameters.threshold: Acceleration >= 5 percentage points
parameters.reason: Finds growth that is strengthening rather than merely remaining positive.
parameters.example: Formula example: YoY growth rises from 9% to 16%, acceleration 7 points, so HIT.

parameters.name: Quarterly EPS Growth YoY
parameters.threshold: EPS growth >= 15%
parameters.reason: Requires profit per share to expand faster than the minimum earnings hurdle.
parameters.example: Formula example: EPS rises from 10 to 12, growth 20%, so HIT.

parameters.name: EPS Growth Acceleration
parameters.threshold: Acceleration >= 5 percentage points
parameters.reason: Detects an inflection in earnings momentum.
parameters.example: Formula example: EPS growth rises from 12% to 22%, acceleration 10 points, so HIT.

parameters.name: Three-Year Revenue CAGR
parameters.threshold: Three-year CAGR >= 12%
parameters.reason: Confirms that current growth sits on a durable base.
parameters.example: Formula example: revenue grows from 1,000 to 1,500 in three years, CAGR 14.5%, so HIT.

parameters.name: Three-Year PAT CAGR
parameters.threshold: Three-year PAT CAGR >= 15%
parameters.reason: Requires profits to compound, not only revenue.
parameters.example: Formula example: PAT grows from 100 to 160 in three years, CAGR 17%, so HIT.

parameters.name: Operating Margin Expansion
parameters.threshold: Expansion >= 1 percentage point
parameters.reason: Tests whether growth is becoming more profitable.
parameters.example: Formula example: OPM rises from 18% to 20%, expansion 2 points, so HIT.

parameters.name: Operating Cash Flow Growth YoY
parameters.threshold: CFO growth >= 12%
parameters.reason: Requires growth to appear in cash generation.
parameters.example: Formula example: CFO rises from 200 to 232, growth 16%, so HIT.

parameters.name: Earnings Stability Eight Quarters
parameters.threshold: All eight quarters positive and variation <= 0.35
parameters.reason: Rejects unstable earnings paths that can inflate a single growth rate.
parameters.example: Formula example: 8 positive quarters and EPS variation 0.24, so HIT.

parameters.name: Result Follow-Through
parameters.threshold: Positive five-day excess return with volume at least 1.3x average
parameters.source: Company result calendar plus Upstox stock and index candles
parameters.reason: Validates that the market accepts reported results.
parameters.example: Formula example: stock +6%, Nifty +1%, volume 1.5x, so HIT.

parameters.name: PE Own-History Percentile
parameters.threshold: Percentile <= 40
parameters.source: Upstox fundamentals and five-year valuation history
parameters.reason: Compares valuation with the company's own cycle rather than a fixed market multiple.
parameters.example: Formula example: current PE sits at the 32nd percentile, so HIT.

parameters.name: PB Own-History Percentile
parameters.threshold: Percentile <= 40
parameters.source: Upstox fundamentals and five-year valuation history
parameters.reason: Finds balance-sheet valuation below the normal company range.
parameters.example: Formula example: current PB sits at the 28th percentile, so HIT.

parameters.name: EV to EBITDA Sector Percentile
parameters.threshold: Sector percentile <= 40
parameters.source: Upstox fundamentals plus NSE sector map
parameters.reason: Compares enterprise valuation against relevant operating peers.
parameters.example: Formula example: multiple 8.2x at sector percentile 35, so HIT.

parameters.name: PEG Ratio
parameters.threshold: PEG <= 1.5 and EPS growth > 0
parameters.reason: Relates price multiple to the demonstrated earnings-growth rate.
parameters.example: Formula example: PE 24 and EPS growth 20% gives PEG 1.2, so HIT.

parameters.name: Free Cash Flow Yield
parameters.threshold: FCF yield >= 4%
parameters.source: Upstox cash-flow statements and market capitalization
parameters.reason: Measures cash return available at the current equity value.
parameters.example: Formula example: FCF 400 and market cap 8,000 gives 5%, so HIT.

parameters.name: Earnings Yield Spread
parameters.threshold: Spread >= 2 percentage points
parameters.reason: Requires an equity earnings premium over the sovereign yield.
parameters.example: Formula example: earnings yield 7% and 10Y yield 4.5% gives 2.5 points, so HIT.

parameters.name: EV to Sales Sector Percentile
parameters.threshold: Sector percentile <= 40
parameters.source: Upstox fundamentals plus NSE sector map
parameters.reason: Adds a revenue-based valuation lens where current profit is distorted.
parameters.example: Formula example: EV/sales 2.1x at sector percentile 37, so HIT.

parameters.name: Quality-Adjusted Valuation
parameters.threshold: Composite score >= 0.75
parameters.source: Upstox fundamentals plus NSE sector map
parameters.reason: Rewards high return on capital without paying an equally extreme multiple.
parameters.example: Formula example: ROIC z 1.4 minus valuation z 0.4 gives 1.0, so HIT.

parameters.name: Promoter Holding Change QoQ
parameters.threshold: Change > 0 percentage points
parameters.reason: Detects fresh promoter accumulation.
parameters.example: Formula example: promoter holding rises from 51.0% to 51.4%, so HIT.

parameters.name: Promoter Pledge Control
parameters.threshold: No pledge increase and total pledge <= 5%
parameters.reason: Blocks rising promoter financing stress.
parameters.example: Formula example: pledge falls from 4% to 3%, so HIT.

parameters.name: FII Holding Change QoQ
parameters.threshold: Change > 0 percentage points
parameters.reason: Detects increasing foreign institutional ownership.
parameters.example: Formula example: FII holding rises from 18.2% to 19.0%, so HIT.

parameters.name: MF or DII Holding Change QoQ
parameters.threshold: Change > 0 percentage points
parameters.reason: Detects increasing domestic institutional sponsorship.
parameters.example: Formula example: domestic institutions rise from 11.1% to 11.8%, so HIT.

parameters.name: Institutional Breadth
parameters.threshold: At least two of three institutional groups increasing
parameters.reason: Requires sponsorship breadth rather than one isolated buyer class.
parameters.example: Formula example: FII and MF rise while DII is flat, count 2, so HIT.

parameters.name: Bulk or Block Buy Follow-Through
parameters.threshold: Documented net buy plus positive 10D excess return
parameters.source: NSE bulk/block deals plus Upstox stock and index candles
parameters.reason: Validates that disclosed institutional demand produces price follow-through.
parameters.example: Formula example: net bulk buy followed by stock +8% versus Nifty +2%, so HIT.

parameters.name: Delivery Percentage Spike
parameters.threshold: Delivery above own 80th percentile with positive close location
parameters.source: NSE bhavcopy delivery data and Upstox candles
parameters.reason: Approximates high-conviction accumulation using delivery participation.
parameters.example: Formula example: delivery 68% versus p80 57%, CLV 0.7, so HIT.

parameters.name: FII Cash Regime Five-Day
parameters.threshold: Five-session cumulative net flow > 0
parameters.reason: Adds market-level institutional risk appetite to stock selection.
parameters.example: Formula example: five-day FII net cash is +Rs 3,200cr, so HIT.

parameters.name: FII Futures Position Shift
parameters.formula: zscore(change in FII net index futures, 60D)
parameters.threshold: Z-score > 1.0
parameters.reason: Detects a material positive shift in foreign index positioning.
parameters.example: Formula example: shift z-score 1.4 exceeds 1.0, so HIT.

parameters.name: PCR and Open-Interest Confirmation
parameters.threshold: Long buildup with PCR inside configured supportive band
parameters.source: NSE futures/options bhavcopy plus Upstox prices
parameters.reason: Confirms price strength with derivatives participation without an extreme put-call state.
parameters.example: Formula example: price +2%, OI +9% and PCR 1.05, so HIT.

parameters.name: Entry Zone Quality
parameters.threshold: Distance <= 0.50 ATR
parameters.source: AshStocks thesis plus Upstox quote and candles
parameters.reason: Prevents chasing a valid thesis too far from its planned entry.
parameters.example: Formula example: price 502, entry midpoint 500 and ATR 8 gives 0.25 ATR, so HIT.

parameters.name: Stop Distance Quality
parameters.threshold: Between 1.0 and 2.5 ATR
parameters.reason: Rejects stops that are either noise-tight or risk-wide.
parameters.example: Formula example: entry 500, stop 488 and ATR 8 gives 1.5 ATR, so HIT.

parameters.name: Target Room
parameters.threshold: At least 15% for positional review; horizon can override
parameters.reason: Requires sufficient remaining upside before entry or continued holding.
parameters.example: Formula example: current 500 and target 600 gives 20% room, so HIT.

parameters.name: Reward to Risk
parameters.threshold: Reward/risk >= 2.0
parameters.reason: Requires asymmetric payoff before simulated capital is committed.
parameters.example: Formula example: entry 500, target 560, stop 475 gives 60/25 = 2.4, so HIT.

parameters.name: Signal Freshness
parameters.threshold: No more than 5 sessions for the default positional review
parameters.source: AshStocks signal ledger and exchange calendar
parameters.reason: Stops an old signal from being treated as a new opportunity.
parameters.example: Formula example: signal age 2 trading sessions, so HIT.

parameters.name: Thesis Invalidation
parameters.threshold: Invalidate on two hard failures or stop breach
parameters.source: AshStocks parameter ledger and Upstox quote
parameters.reason: Converts changing evidence into an explicit exit state.
parameters.example: Formula example: one hard failure and price above stop means not invalidated; two failures means EXIT.

parameters.name: Hold or Exit State
parameters.formula: HOLD if score >= 70 and not invalidated; otherwise EXIT
parameters.threshold: Score floor 70 with no thesis invalidation
parameters.source: AshStocks score, paper ledger and Upstox quote
parameters.reason: Makes the continuing-position decision deterministic and auditable.
parameters.example: Formula example: score 76 and no invalidation gives HOLD; score 64 gives EXIT.

parameters.name: Replacement Edge
parameters.threshold: Candidate must lead by 10 points and pass reward/risk
parameters.source: AshStocks ranked universe and paper portfolio
parameters.reason: Controls sell-and-replace decisions instead of rotating on small score noise.
parameters.example: Formula example: candidate 84 versus holding 71 gives +13 and RR 2.3, so HIT.

parameters.name: Ichimoku Cloud State
parameters.threshold: Price above the projected cloud
parameters.reason: Adds a multi-period trend and support structure not covered by simple averages.
parameters.example: Formula example: close 525, Span A 510 and Span B 506, so HIT.

parameters.name: Tenkan Kijun Bullish Cross
parameters.formula: Tenkan crosses above Kijun while close is above cloud
parameters.threshold: Fresh bullish cross with cloud confirmation
parameters.reason: Requires short-cycle momentum to align with Ichimoku trend context.
parameters.example: Formula example: Tenkan moves 508 to 514 above Kijun 512 with close above cloud, so HIT.

parameters.name: Stochastic RSI Reclaim
parameters.formula: StochRSI_K crosses above StochRSI_D from below 20
parameters.threshold: Bullish cross after an oversold reading
parameters.reason: Detects momentum recovery earlier than absolute return filters.
parameters.example: Formula example: K rises from 14 to 26 above D 21 after both were below 20, so HIT.

parameters.name: Money Flow Index
parameters.formula: MFI14 using typical price and volume
parameters.threshold: MFI between 50 and 80 and rising
parameters.reason: Combines price and volume into a bounded accumulation signal.
parameters.example: Formula example: MFI rises from 55 to 63 and remains below 80, so HIT.

parameters.name: Chaikin Money Flow
parameters.reason: Tests whether closes and volume indicate sustained buying pressure.
parameters.example: Formula example: CMF20 is 0.16, above 0.10, so HIT.

parameters.name: Keltner Bollinger Squeeze Release
parameters.formula: BB inside Keltner, then close > upper_BB and volume_ratio > 1.5
parameters.threshold: Confirmed upper release after squeeze
parameters.reason: Combines compression, directional break and participation in one auditable trigger.
parameters.example: Formula example: prior BB inside KC, close breaks upper BB and volume is 1.8x, so HIT.

parameters.name: Entry overrun versus planned zone
parameters.threshold: Do not chase more than 0.5 ATR above the approved entry zone.
parameters.source: Upstox market quote + ASH entry zone + ATR14
parameters.reason: Prevents a valid idea becoming a poor trade because price has already run away.
parameters.example: Entry high Rs 500, ATR Rs 20, last Rs 507: overrun 0.35 ATR, so HIT.

parameters.name: Holding-period expiry
parameters.threshold: Position remains valid only inside the maximum sessions for its declared horizon.
parameters.source: Mongo paper position ledger + NSE trading calendar
parameters.reason: Stops a tactical trade from silently becoming a permanent holding.
parameters.example: Swing horizon 40 sessions and age 31: HIT; age 41: EXIT review.

parameters.name: Target 1 partial-booking trigger
parameters.threshold: Book the configured first tranche when real price reaches T1.
parameters.source: Upstox quote + Mongo paper order/position ledger
parameters.reason: Turns target progress into a persisted paper lifecycle event.
parameters.example: T1 Rs 620, last Rs 624, nothing booked: trigger 50% paper exit.

parameters.name: Post-T1 ATR trailing stop
parameters.threshold: After T1, the stop may only rise and trails the highest close by two ATR.
parameters.source: Upstox candles + Mongo paper position ledger
parameters.reason: Protects gains while leaving room for a larger trend.
parameters.example: Highest close Rs 700 and ATR Rs 24 gives trail Rs 652; existing Rs 640 becomes Rs 652.

parameters.name: Market-direction alignment
parameters.threshold: Long candidates must align with a positive NIFTY trend unless tagged contrarian.
parameters.source: Upstox stock candles + Upstox NIFTY 50 candles
parameters.reason: Reduces long entries fighting the broad market.
parameters.example: Stock above SMA50 and NIFTY above SMA50: HIT.

parameters.name: News or regime early-exit trigger
parameters.threshold: Exit review fires on a verified adverse event or a validated high-risk market regime.
parameters.source: NSE corporate announcements + verified news/event feed + ASH regime engine
parameters.reason: Protects the paper portfolio from thesis-breaking information.
parameters.example: Credit downgrade plus gap below stop support: early-exit node fires.
parameters.required: timestamped verified event and regime state

parameters.name: Portfolio beta after proposed trade
parameters.threshold: The proposed position must keep weighted portfolio beta at or below the configured cap.
parameters.source: Upstox daily candles + Mongo paper portfolio
parameters.reason: Controls total portfolio sensitivity, not only single-stock volatility.
parameters.example: Portfolio beta moves from 1.05 to 1.14: HIT; to 1.28: BLOCK.

parameters.name: Sector concentration after proposed trade
parameters.threshold: No sector may exceed 25% after adding the candidate.
parameters.source: Mongo paper portfolio + NSE sector mapping
parameters.reason: Prevents several individually good stocks creating one concentrated bet.
parameters.example: Banking would become 29% after order: BLOCK.

parameters.name: Position risk contribution
parameters.threshold: A new position may contribute at most 20% of aggregate ATR risk.
parameters.reason: Sizes by risk contribution instead of equal rupee value alone.
parameters.example: Candidate contributes 14% of portfolio ATR risk: HIT.
parameters.required: qty, price, ATR14 for all positions

parameters.name: Cross-sectional relative-strength rank
parameters.threshold: Candidate must rank in the top 30% of the real scanned NSE pool by 12-month return.
parameters.source: Upstox daily candles across current scan pool
parameters.reason: Measures leadership against alternatives available at the same time.
parameters.example: 12M return ranks at the 84th percentile: HIT.

parameters.name: EPS rank
parameters.threshold: Composite EPS strength must rank in the top 30% of the covered NSE pool.
parameters.source: Quarterly company results from NSE filings
parameters.reason: Combines earnings growth, acceleration and stability into comparable leadership.
parameters.example: EPS composite at 78th percentile: HIT.

parameters.name: Thirteen-week accumulation/distribution grade
parameters.threshold: Grade A/B when 13-week up-volume materially exceeds down-volume.
parameters.reason: Shows whether price strength is supported by persistent demand.
parameters.example: Up volume 84m and down volume 55m gives 1.53 ratio: grade A, HIT.

parameters.name: Industry-group rank
parameters.threshold: Candidate industry group must rank above the 60th percentile.
parameters.source: Upstox returns + verified NSE industry mapping
parameters.reason: A strong stock in a strengthening group has broader confirmation.
parameters.example: Defence group median RS is 82nd percentile: HIT.

parameters.name: Weekly composite-score improvement
parameters.threshold: The evidence score must improve across two consecutive five-week windows.
parameters.reason: Confirms improving evidence instead of a one-day score spike.
parameters.example: Recent five-week average 74 versus prior 66: HIT.

parameters.name: Distance from pivot
parameters.threshold: Entry must be within 5% of the prior 20-session pivot.
parameters.reason: Avoids chasing breakouts far beyond their decision level.
parameters.example: Pivot Rs 400 and last Rs 414 gives 3.5% distance: HIT.

parameters.name: Volume versus 50-day average
parameters.threshold: Latest session volume must be at least 1.5 times its 50-day mean for confirmation.
parameters.reason: Separates real participation from thin price movement.
parameters.example: Latest volume 3.2m versus 1.8m average gives 1.78x: HIT.

parameters.name: Price to operating cash flow
parameters.threshold: P/CFO must not exceed the approved own-history or sector threshold.
parameters.reason: Checks valuation against cash generation rather than accounting profit alone.
parameters.example: P/CFO 14 versus sector limit 18: HIT.

parameters.name: ASM surveillance flag
parameters.threshold: Stocks currently under Additional Surveillance Measure are excluded from automatic paper entry.
parameters.reason: Prevents automated entry when exchange surveillance conditions are elevated.
parameters.example: Symbol absent from current ASM list: CLEAR.

parameters.name: GSM surveillance flag
parameters.threshold: Stocks currently under Graded Surveillance Measure are excluded from automatic paper entry.
parameters.reason: Treats exchange surveillance as a hard execution constraint.
parameters.example: Symbol appears in GSM stage 2: BLOCK.

parameters.name: Unsolicited-message warning
parameters.threshold: A current exchange warning about unsolicited stock messages blocks automatic entry.
parameters.reason: Reduces pump-and-dump and manipulation exposure.
parameters.example: No current warning for symbol: CLEAR.

parameters.name: Dilution-adjusted EPS growth
parameters.threshold: EPS growth must remain positive after actual share-count dilution.
parameters.source: Quarterly NSE results + share capital history
parameters.reason: Stops headline PAT growth hiding per-share dilution.
parameters.example: PAT +12% but diluted shares +3% gives adjusted EPS growth about 8.7%: HIT.

parameters.name: Diversification delta
parameters.threshold: Candidate must reduce or not materially worsen weighted portfolio correlation.
parameters.source: Upstox daily returns + Mongo paper portfolio
parameters.reason: Rewards candidates that improve portfolio structure, not only standalone score.
parameters.example: Weighted correlation falls from 0.61 to 0.56: HIT.

parameters.name: Relative volume at current time
parameters.threshold: Intraday volume must be at least 1.5 times the normal volume at the same time of day.
parameters.reason: Avoids comparing morning partial volume with an entire prior day.
parameters.example: 11:00 volume is 2.1m versus same-time median 1.2m: 1.75x HIT.

parameters.name: Earnings-date proximity
parameters.threshold: Automatic momentum entry is blocked inside two trading days of results unless an event strategy is selected.
parameters.reason: Makes earnings-gap risk explicit before entry.
parameters.example: Results tomorrow and normal momentum strategy: BLOCK.

parameters.name: Dividend payout sustainability
parameters.threshold: Payout must be covered by operating cash flow with a safety buffer.
parameters.reason: Distinguishes sustainable distributions from balance-sheet-funded payouts.
parameters.example: Cash dividend Rs 700cr and CFO Rs 1,100cr gives 64% payout and 1.57x cover: HIT.

parameters.name: Dividend growth streak
parameters.threshold: Dividend per share must grow for at least three consecutive financial years.
parameters.reason: Identifies repeatable shareholder-return policy rather than a one-off payout.
parameters.example: DPS rises 8, 9, 10.5, 12 across four years: three-year streak HIT.

parameters.name: Quote age
parameters.formula: now - quote_timestamp <= 5 seconds during market hours
parameters.threshold: A market fill requires an Upstox quote no older than five seconds while NSE is open.
parameters.reason: Prevents paper fills on stale prices.
parameters.example: Quote age 2.4 seconds: HIT; 18 seconds: BLOCK.

parameters.name: Bid-ask spread
parameters.threshold: The top-of-book spread must be at most 25 basis points for an automatic market entry.
parameters.reason: Makes paper fills respect executable liquidity.
parameters.example: Bid 500.00 and ask 500.60 gives about 12 bps: HIT.

parameters.name: Depth imbalance
parameters.threshold: Five-level depth must not show sell-side imbalance worse than -0.20.
parameters.reason: Blocks entries when visible supply heavily dominates demand.
parameters.example: Buy 90k, sell 110k gives -0.10: HIT.

parameters.name: Estimated market impact
parameters.threshold: Estimated depth-walking impact must remain within 20 basis points.
parameters.source: Upstox market depth + paper order quantity
parameters.reason: Stops simulated fills from assuming unlimited liquidity at LTP.
parameters.example: Weighted ask fill implies 14 bps impact: HIT.

parameters.name: Fill slippage
parameters.threshold: Recorded paper fill slippage must be no more than 25 basis points.
parameters.source: Paper order ledger + Upstox decision quote
parameters.reason: Measures whether execution preserved the signal economics.
parameters.example: Decision Rs 500, fill Rs 500.80 gives 16 bps: HIT.

parameters.name: Trigger-to-fill latency
parameters.threshold: A market paper order should fill within five seconds of its valid trigger during market hours.
parameters.reason: Exposes delayed processing that can invalidate momentum fills.
parameters.example: Trigger 10:01:05.100, fill 10:01:07.200 gives 2.1s: HIT.

parameters.name: Partial-fill ratio
parameters.threshold: Automatic paper entry is complete only when the requested quantity can be supported by depth.
parameters.source: Paper order ledger + Upstox market depth
parameters.reason: Prevents a partial fill being displayed as a full position.
parameters.example: Requested 100, depth-supported fill 100: ratio 1.0 HIT.

parameters.name: Circuit or rejection state
parameters.formula: last_price inside circuit band and exchange_restriction = false
parameters.threshold: Automatic entry is blocked at circuit limits or when exchange/broker market-data state marks the instrument restricted.
parameters.source: Upstox quote circuit limits + NSE instrument status
parameters.reason: Applies real exchange constraints to paper execution.
parameters.example: LTP below upper circuit and symbol tradable: CLEAR.

freshnessGate.name: Fresh candle within five sessions
freshnessGate.threshold: Latest stored candle must be no more than seven calendar days old.
freshnessGate.source: AshStocks B24 realtime quality and Upstox candles
freshnessGate.reason: Prevents stale evidence from being presented as current selection evidence.
freshnessGate.example: Formula example: latest candle age 2 days is within 7 days, so the gate is open.
